Q: My Google oauth2 client id does not appear in Google API Console A:

I realized that I was in a wrong project. I changed my project (top left next to Google Console), and then I saw my Client ID.

This fixed my Cliend ID disappearing from Google Console.

Q: Convert date in Excel 12-Oct-1968 A:

In VBA you would use DateValue to convert a text date to a true DateTime value which can be used for your calculations:

Dim TrueDate As Date

TextDate = "12-Oct-1968"
TrueDate = DateValue(TextDate)

Note, that TrueDate holds no format; it is a numeric value. Apply the format to the cells where the values will be displayed.

Q: Running a windows reg add command in non-interactive mode A:

You can either use the /F flag as mentioned by Compo in the comments, or you can use a .reg file and start it in silent mode:

start regedit /s "C:\path\to\regfile.reg"

Q: powershell - add array to existing nested hash table A:

Thanks everybody for their responses. I finally achieved to do it. I created another object with custom properties, and then I fullfilled the hash table. This is the code:

$myObjectProperties = @(
"Brokering"
"PVSServer"
"Name"
"VDA"
"WMI"
"vDisk"
"dFreeSpace"
"WriteCacheSize"
"Spooler"
"CitrixPrint"
"Uptime"
"cFreeSpace"
"RunspaceId"
)
foreach ($element in $results){
    foreach ($property in $myObjectProperties){
        $allresults.$($element.Name).$property = $element.$property
    }
}

Q: How to write class object to bin file A:

Yes, you can serialize and save the objects using the OutputStream/InputStream classes. However do watch out when you modify the class (add/delete/modify an instance variable for example) and then try to read a previously saved file.
